Río frío → Abrigo del.melgar is 66 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Abrigo del.melgar → Úbeda is 42 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Úbeda → back through Abrigo del.melgar is 42 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
back through Abrigo del.melgar → back through Río frío is 66 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

places-hondares-ubeda.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-hondares-ubeda.story: 373 km from Moratalla to Moratalla, about 6 h 26 of riding. On the way it passes Abrigo de la Rambla de Pedro Izquierdo, Río frío, Abrigo del.melgar and Úbeda. The highest point is about 1,450 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
